sv.title: Socialdemokraterna borde syna Jimmie Åkessons vilja
sv.summary: Om Centerpartiet går högerut går arbetarrörelsen miste om regeringsmakten, men kan samtidigt ta chansen att gripa makten i riksdagen, skriver Max Jerneck, chefsekonom Katalys

en.title: Social Democrats Should Heed Jimmie Åkesson's Will
en.summary: If the Centre Party moves to the right, the labour movement will lose government power, but could at the same time seize the chance to take power in the Riksdag, writes Max Jerneck, chief economist at Katalys
